---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a command, harness, setting or workflow change
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today?

## Proposed change

The command, flag, harness, browser UI change or docs change you have in mind.
Say whether it affects the Source, Followers, or both.

## Why it matters

Who benefits, and what becomes easier or safer?

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you use now, or other designs you considered.
